short_description: MMIRS (MMT and Magellan Infrared Spectrograph) filters, MMT listing

licence.scope: No licence or reuse statement was found on the CfA-hosted page that serves the curves or on the CfA site pages checked (https://www.cfa.harvard.edu/ footer has only a Mailchimp terms link; /privacy-policy and /terms-use returned 404). The MMT Observatory site footer (https://www.mmto.org/after-your-run/) says 'All rights reserved' but belongs to the telescope's site, not the instrument team's page, so it is not taken as the owner's statement. The MMT credit line is recorded because the instrument runs at the MMT. Page cited by SVO: https://www.cfa.harvard.edu/mmti/mmirs/instrstats.html (redirects to lweb.cfa.harvard.edu). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: Observations reported here were obtained at the MMT Observatory, a joint facility of the Smithsonian Institution and the University of Arizona.
